mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates, thus negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month indicates increased economic output, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening consumer demand, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS decreases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over six months, coupled with a stable or decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), indicates strong economic growth without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% in 6 months and FEDFUNDS stable or decrease
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over six months and FEDFUNDS is stable or decreases.
